% xr's old release loaded before hyperref, as many documents do. Each
% reference to a label of an .aux that LaTeX wrote under hyperref prints
% as in the PDF: its number, page, name, and \autoref, with no link. The
% \@input{chap.aux} of that .aux is read beside this document, where no
% chap.aux is, so its label prints ??, as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xr}[=v5]
\usepackage{hyperref}
\externaldocument[X-]{test-xr/latex}
\begin{document}
CaseL \ref{X-ss}, page \pageref{X-front}, named \nameref{X-thm}, auto \autoref{X-thm}.
Included \ref{X-c}.

\section{Here}\label{here}
Local \ref{here}.
\end{document}
